# Reverse parser admission: known legacy syntax and diagnostic recovery.

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:fiber-function-name grammar-lab Appendix A Name: a declaration's own name takes the enclosing context's parameters, so effect function join() {} at module level derives; the lab applies [+Effect] to every name after effect; lane impl-hunt-admission

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:join-for-head compiler VIP-17: join is exactly as await, and TypeScript rejects `for (await x of xs)` with TS2487; `for (join x of xs)` reports only the operand error EK4611; lane impl-hunt-admission
